title: Megurine Luka — Support Under The Blazing Sun〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just want to be able to compose a song that can save people... I need to do everything I can to achieve that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's my goal...
That's what I have to compose...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kanade...!
Would it be alright for me to give you my support?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um... In my case...
If I keep pushing myself after deciding to do something, I start getting really tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, if you think you need it, Kanade, even if things get really tough or difficult, I want to give you my support in a way that helps you move forward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I kept an eye on how Kanade was doing all day, but it was very interesting to see her give exercising a try even though she's not very used to it.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was told by one of them today that they wanted to “see me smile”, and how everyone in N25 probably feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was kind of startled since it was the first time I'd ever been told anything like that. However...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If what they said is true... If they all feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll take what you said into closer consideration, Luka, and think more about how I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (If she thinks more about how she herself is doing...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(If Kanade begins doing that...
I wonder how it'll affect the music she composes.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing that change.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
It's rare of you to come to meet me yourself, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've been grinning for a while now... Just what exactly are you scheming this time?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? Scheming?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Were you sitting by yourself and grinning again, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did something fun happen...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you mean “grinning”?
I was crying just now because something very sad happened.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is that true...?
I'm sorry, I didn't know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't fall for that...
I guarantee that she's lying.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rin, you're so mean.
I was just joking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How's that supposed to be fun?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course it's fun.
We're close friends enjoying a little bit of playful banter.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not sure this actually amounts to “banter”...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Let's move over there, Miku, Len.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you don't want to hear the story about how I saw Kanade struggling to stand up while wearing rollerblades like a newborn fawn?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A newborn fawn...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rollerblades...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you've been gone from SEKAI all day. Did you go off to see Kanade during that time...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I did.
I was told that Kanade and Ena would be going out for a walk today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't believe they went from that to rollerblading, playing bubble sumo and some other things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Bubble sumo?
What kind of “bubble”?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to hear more?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, as long as you stay on topic...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be going now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll tell the rest of you about all the things I saw Kanade do today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.
